scientific_question: Can a method-faithful two-scalar spherical-PLDA multi-enrollment backend correct known-speaker ranking errors while leaving the validated CAM++ known/unknown decision exactly unchanged?

literature.paper: Sholokhov et al., Probabilistic Back-ends for Online Speaker Recognition and Clustering, ICASSP 2023
literature.method: center with the target fold training mean, length-normalize, fit spherical PLDA b/w by 10 EM iterations, then perform set-to-vector LLR scoring

fixed_phase_one_policy.fit_rows: known-speaker embeddings from the matching training split only
fixed_phase_one_policy.speaker_decision: argmax spherical-PLDA LLR over the 446 known enrollment sets
fixed_phase_one_policy.ood_decision: copy the raw probability-average CAM++ argmax decision exactly; rerank only rows already predicted as known

phase_one_gate.passing_action: Run the identical fixed reranker across every available seed42 OOF fold and require positive Macro-F1 direction on all three folds before designing a separately preregistered leave-one-fold-out OOD calibration.
phase_one_gate.failing_action: Reject spherical-PLDA known reranking for that representation; do not tune EM iterations, centering, score scale, thresholds, or blends on the failed target fold.
